title: Where Personal Computing is Going:  ExplainingComputers video
author: Y
text:
Xebec
Well-known member

On the topic of, "Where is the PC market going", I'd like to share a video EC made that covers the topic of how desktop and home PCs are evolving in the AI age:

Take-aways:

For hardware, the vast majority of the PC market will be "System in Package", and the ability to build your own PC will be reserved for very high end $$ builds. Unified memory and the way AI applications work are the drivers behind this change.

For software, Agentic interfaces will replace the GUI desktop and applications.
- Replacing mainstream software with AI written software (i.e. Adobe suite) isn't the big change, it's just a temporary prelude.
- Instead, when you interface with your computer in an Agentic fashion, it'll create documents internally rather than using legacy applications

He also talks about the mindset shift he's working through to get used to how things will be going forward, talking about previous changes in the industry. Using a GUI with stand alone desktop applications will be considered a retro computing activity in the future.
